title: Comparison CTA Viewed→Contact merge has no test (existing negative test is now stale)
evidence:
column_headers.gleam:132 → `    application.Shortlisted | application.Viewed ->`
decide_dock.gleam:66 → `    application.Shortlisted | application.Viewed ->`
The only relevant test (client_test.gleam:3518-3522) now asserts a stale invariant:
`  // Negative invariant: the Contact CTA testid (and the matching dock
  // entry) is exposed only on the Shortlisted column.`
Its `details` list (client_test.gleam:3523-3543) seeds only Submitted, UnderReview, Rejected — no Viewed entry — so it cannot detect whether a Viewed app renders the Contact CTA. `rg -n "application.Viewed" client/test/client_test.gleam` returns only the status_pill line (1535).
detail: Behaviour #8 (Viewed merged into the Shortlisted Contact arm, 2 files) is a deliberate routing change with zero coverage. Removing `| application.Viewed` would not fail any test, and the existing negative test's claim is now false.
recommended_fix: Add a comparison-page test rendering an `application.Viewed` detail and asserting `comparison-cta-contact-<id>` and `dock-contact-<id>` render; update the stale comment in `comparison_page_cta_contact_button_only_on_shortlisted_test`.

title: status_pill recolour of UnderReview/Shortlisted/Approved has no pinning test
evidence:
status_pill.gleam:26 → `          class(pill_base <> " bg-navy/10 text-navy"),` (UnderReview, was bg-amber)
status_pill.gleam:34 → `          class(pill_base <> " bg-amber/10 text-amber"),` (Shortlisted, was score-strong)
status_pill.gleam:50 → `          class(pill_base <> " bg-teal/10 text-teal"),` (Approved, was score-strong)
The only status-pill testid/colour assertions in client tests are `status-pill-submitted` (client_test.gleam:1526) and `status-pill-viewed` + `bg-navy/10 text-navy` (client_test.gleam:1537-1539). `rg -n 'status-pill-(under-review|shortlisted|approved)' client/test/` returns nothing.
detail: Behaviour #5 is partial: the new Viewed arm is pinned, but the deliberate recolour of three existing statuses (a headline AC item) has no test. A silent revert of any of the three colours would pass CI.
recommended_fix: Add render assertions for status_pill.view(UnderReview)→navy, (Shortlisted)→amber, (Approved)→teal, mirroring the existing Viewed pin.

title: Server 400 message listing 'viewed' is not asserted (parse_status acceptance is covered)
evidence:
application_detail_handler.gleam:570 → `            "Status must be one of: under_review, shortlisted, viewed, approved, rejected",`
The invalid-status integration test (application_integration_test.gleam:235) asserts only the code: `  |> should.equal(error_code.InvalidStatus)` — it never reads the response body message. `rg -n "Status must be one of" server/test/` returns no test references.
detail: Behaviour #3 is partial: parse_status accepting "viewed" is pinned (parse_status_viewed_test), but the 400 message text listing viewed is not. Informational only; low regression risk.
recommended_fix: Optionally assert the 400 response body contains "viewed" in the existing invalid-status integration test, or accept the parse_status unit pin as sufficient.

title: leaderboard status_rank Viewed position is not exercised by any sort test
evidence:
leaderboard_view.gleam:784-786 → `    application.Viewed -> 3
    application.Approved -> 4
    application.Rejected -> 5`
The only SortByStatus test (client_test.gleam:2105 `sort_by_status_asc_test`) seeds only Rejected, Submitted, Shortlisted (client_test.gleam:2108-2122) and asserts `ids |> should.equal(["e2", "e3", "e1"])`. No Viewed (or Approved/AutoClosed) entry is sorted, so the Viewed=3 insertion is unobserved; the test passes under the old numbering too.
detail: Behaviour #6 renumbering is partially covered: the relative order of the three tested statuses is preserved, but no test pins that Viewed sorts between Shortlisted and Approved. Trivial function, low risk.
recommended_fix: Extend sort_by_status_asc_test with Shortlisted, Viewed, Approved entries asserting Viewed lands between them, or add a focused status_rank case.

title: New viewed render arms (stepper stop_tone, detail-page header pill) lack render assertions
evidence:
status_stepper.gleam:268 → `    True, _, application.Viewed -> #("bg-navy text-white", "")`
status_stepper.gleam:273 → `    _, True, application.Viewed -> #("bg-navy/10 text-navy", "✓ ")`
application_detail.gleam:541 → `    application.Viewed -> #("bg-navy/10 text-navy", "VIEWED")`
`rg -n "stop_tone|view_status_pill|label_for_slug_opt|slug_for_index" client/test/` returns only comment hits in status_stepper_test.gleam — no function is called and no render output is asserted for these arms. (stop_tone has `_ ->` catch-alls, so a missing viewed arm would not be a compile error.)
detail: Behaviours #4 (render half) and #7 have no render test; the stepper logic (rank/clamp/focus/direction) and the shared status_pill Viewed arm ARE covered. These arms' existence is partly compile-enforced (detail pill) or not (stop_tone catches), but colour/label regressions would slip through.
recommended_fix: Add a stepper render test asserting the viewed active stop carries `bg-navy text-white`, and a detail-page header assertion for the VIEWED pill — or accept status_pill's Viewed pin as the brand-set proxy.

title: Advisory test gate: CONCERNS
evidence: P0 paths FULL: shared codec round-trip (shared/test/application_test.gleam every_status_round_trips_test, status_decoder_accepts_all_test, viewed_wire_string_test), server parse_status acceptance (parse_status_viewed_test), PATCH→viewed audit row (patch_status_to_viewed_writes_audit_row_test asserts 200, status_after="viewed", audit_count=1, from/to details). P1 logic FULL: stepper rank/clamp(=4)/focus_index(viewed=Some 3)/direction (3 new viewed tests). Gaps cluster in UI render/routing + informational copy: comparison CTA merge (#8, NONE, warning), status_pill recolour of 3 existing statuses (#5 partial), status_rank viewed position (#6), 400 message text (#3 partial), viewed render arms in stop_tone/detail pill (#4 render, #7).
detail: P0=100%, P1≈100% (contract-critical codec/parse_status/audit paths fully pinned). Overall ≈75%: 3 of 9 behaviours have core coverage with untested render/secondary halves, and the comparison CTA merge is a deliberate routing change with zero coverage and a now-stale negative test.
